title: Tokyo Cement Group raises second-quarter sales in 2027 financial year
summary: Tokyo Cement Group raises second-quarter sales in 2027 financial year
body_markdown:
**Sri Lanka:** Tokyo Cement Group recorded sales of US$63.1m in the second quarter of its 2027 financial year, up by 28% year-on-year. Daily FT News has reported that the producer attributed the growth to price rises and an increased market share, partly due to a new maritime connection to Sri Lanka’s Western Province and beyond. Nonetheless, profit after tax dropped by 13%, to US$2.63m, due to increased raw material costs and currency effects.


Tokyo Cement Group says that it is well positioned to capitalise on future industry growth. It maintains a ‘conservative’ short-to-medium-term growth outlook and plans to ‘maintain cost discipline.’
